summary: ORBIT iteration-2 regression + business-integration/tool-layer testing. Prior 24/24 regression suite (backend_test.py) also re-run and all pass -> 36/36 total. Frontend (Playwright, live URL): Landing repositioned correctly - hero 'Your AI employee, built around your business.', eyebrow 'AI employees for real businesses', 'Built for your business' section with all 6 verticals (Hotels/Restaurants/Clinics/Real estate/Agencies/Retail), 'More than a chatbot' section present, 'elevenlabs' text NOT present anywhere on public landing. Taj tenant Integrations page renders MOCK notice banner, 4 system cards (Hotel PMS w/ MOCK badge, Phone Connected, WhatsApp Action Required, AI Employee Riya Live), 3 tool cards; clicking Test on check_availability returns visibly labelled 'MOCK / demo data (not real)' result. Conversations detail sheet for a simulate-call conversation shows conversation-data-source block with 'Data source: MOCK / demo', live_data_note and check_availability tool invocation payload. Admin console TenantDetailSheet for Taj shows Business Integrations section with Hotel PMS row (MOCK badge, Connected status select, Mock mode select), 3 tool rows (READ Check room availability / Enabled, READ Check booking status / Enabled, ACTION Create booking / Disabled) with per-tool toggle buttons, add-integration-btn and add-tool-btn present; verified add-integration + add-tool flows end-to-end (TEST_Clinic Calendar + Check slots + Book slot on Leela). Baseline restored (Taj PMS mock/connected, create_booking disabled).

issues: Right-side sheet content (per-tool Enabled/Disabled toggle buttons) is clipped horizontally at 1440px viewport - the buttons render but sit outside the visible sheet area (require horizontal scroll). Consider constraining the sheet width or wrapping the tool row so the toggle is always in view.

(design/a11y, non-blocking) Ensure per-tool toggle button in admin Business Integrations tool row stays within the sheet viewport at 1440px - currently clipped and requires horizontal scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: tools.run_tool correctly never fabricates data: when integration.mode=='live' but LIVE_REGISTRY is empty, returns status='unavailable' (verified by test). Good.
Action tools have requires_confirmation FORCED true in both create_tool and update_tool code paths - defence in depth. Good.
Tenant preview endpoint queries tools scoped by tenant_id (find_one with {id, tenant_id}), so cross-tenant preview correctly 404s. Good.
connectors.py MockPMSConnector uses random.random() for availability - fine for demo but non-deterministic in tests; tests only assert keys, not values. OK.
routes_business.py: no pagination on list endpoints (to_list(100)/(200)); fine for demo scale.
seed.py sets create_booking enabled=false + requires_confirmation=true - matches the safety promise. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows: landing repositioning + no ElevenLabs, tenant Integrations MOCK preview, conversation data-source, admin Business Integrations UI + add-integration + add-tool + toggle)
